messages:
rita: Heads-up: nightly recert reported unexpected admin holders in production. quick triage? :warning:
ken: can you paste the event sample?
rita: `grant:0x9cfa, actor:role-resolver, principal:svc-logger-prod, assigned:admin, ts:2026-03-20T23:11:04Z`
fani: role-resolver should map `alias:log-service` -> `svc-logger` not to admin. Did KMS role-map change?
sec-bot: KMS audit: secret 'role-map/prod' rotated 2026-03-20T22:45Z to v15; later an automated rollback to v14 at 2026-03-20T22:59Z by `kms-promote-batch` job.
ken: that rollback aligns with recert run at 23:10. suspect resolver read v14 which still had legacy alias mapping to admin.
oncall-sre: I've temporarily set `authz suspend-alias-resolution --env prod` to prevent further alias-driven grants.
rita: good. next steps: 1) snapshot affected grants, 2) dry-run demote where safe, 3) add secret-version logging to resolver, 4) fix KMS promote script.
fani: drafting quick fix: change resolver to fail loudly if alias resolution returns a high-priv mapping and secret version != manifest.expected_rolemap_version. snippet: `if [[ $secret_version != $EXPECTED ]]; then echo "secret mismatch"; exit 1; fi`
ken: run an LD-audit for principals with grants in last 7 days. sec-bot: LD-Audit job 91234 queued. ETA 10m.
sec-bot: LD-Audit complete: 5 principals with admin unexpectedly assigned; 4 are service tokens, 1 is a human emergency account (escalate).
rita: we should only auto-demote the service tokens after owner notification. for the human account, create a temporary hold and page owner.
oncall-sre: created pager: owner oncall, paging now.
ken: propose safe plan: `rbac reconcile --principals file://suspect.json --map legacy-alias:svc-role --mode dry-run` then apply with 30m rollback window. capture pre/post scans and KMS secret versions.
fani: I'll add `secrethash` and `secret_version` into resolver logs: `log.info("role-resolver", "ver", ver, "sha", sha256)` and add a gated check in the deploy pipeline preventing promote of older versions into prod without human approval.
rita: file ticket SEC-4310 with owners: ken (remediation), rita (audit evidence), fani (code change), oncall-sre (ops run). scheduling postmortem in security board. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
